title: Parsing Gigabytes of JSON per Second

title: Sep 0.10.0 - 21 GB/s CSV Parsing Using SIMD on AMD 9950X

title: Sep 0.11.0 - 9.5 GB/s CSV Parsing Using ARM NEON SIMD on Apple M1

title: GpJSON: High-performance JSON Data Processing on GPUs
relevance: GPU-based two-phase JSON processing: parallel structural index construction + in-situ querying, achieving 2.9x over simdjson.

title: Scalable Data-Parallel Processing of Semi-Structured Data
relevance: Comprehensive treatment of scalable semi-structured data parsing, covering bit-parallel techniques and structural indexing at scale.
